attributes.board_name: Massachusetts Board of Registration of Social Workers

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by a recognized entity: CSWE-accredited social work programs, ASWB ACE, NASW or NASW chapters, National Association of Black Social Workers or its chapters, another US/Canadian social work licensing entity, or Board-authorized organizations. Up to 25% may be approved by APA, NBCC, NHA board, ANCC or ACCME. Individual activities (Board approval) max 50%.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First licensure period pro-rated: licensed in 1st quarter 75%, 2nd quarter 50%, 3rd quarter 25%, last quarter none (258 CMR 31.03(3)).
rules.alternatives: Exempt: social workers employed exclusively by a Massachusetts state, county or municipal unit for the entire cycle (affidavit). No exemption for retired or unemployed.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; keep CE certificates at least 2 renewal cycles (4 years).

topics.who: Anti-racism with a focus on oppression (Board policy, renewals since Sept 28, 2023)
Anti-discrimination (ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, religion, immigration status, disability, etc.)
At least one domestic violence and sexual violence training as a condition of licensure/renewal (M.G.L. c. 112, s. 264; 258 CMR 31.03(4))

rules.legal_basis: 258 CMR 31.00; M.G.L. c. 112, s. 264; Board Anti-Racism and Anti-Discrimination CE Policy (2021)
rules.notes: License cycle runs biennially from the licensee's birthday. CE hour = at least 50 minutes. No limit on online CE. Anti-racism/anti-discrimination hours count within the total. School PDPs not accepted.
